noise_policy: Keep nominal pixels. Timestamp-based noise replay is diagnostic only; no corrected-band substitution or automatic masking.
crop: Integer centre of half-open bbox; complete unresampled 75x75 context containing the whole bbox
incidence_policy: Finite centre incidence strictly between 0 and 90 degrees; retain exact value. This is validity, not a validated operating range.
qualification: Research processing only. Product-specific evidence and scope checks are the caller's responsibility. Additional checks do not establish absolute geolocation, Kaggle equivalence or learned transfer.
